The petitioner's sample was drawn on 10.03.2011 and finding that petitioner's product was misbranded, prosecution was launched against the petitioner under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act of 1954").

2. While informing that the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 had actually come into force after the Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Business) Regulations, 2011 were published on 01.08.2011, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the State has decided to withdraw prosecution under the Act of 1954 in a number of cases but the same is being done selectively and not in all cases.
